programme.title: 直播丨2026 Shanghai Global Asset Management Forum
programme.desc: As China’s hub for financial opening-up, Shanghai, leveraging the sound financial infrastructures, an ecosystem hub for both domestic and foreign institutions, and continuously iteration connectivity mechanisms, is inherently tasked with the core mission of linking global capital with China’s domestic market and coordinating development and security. At this pivotal juncture, Yicai, together with Bank of China, once again hosts the Shanghai Global Asset Management Forum. Adopting a top-level perspective, the forum aligns the country’s medium- and long-term strategic arrangements with the latest policy blueprint for Shanghai’s global asset management centre, and creates a high-end dialogue platform bringing together regulators, academia, leading Chinese and foreign asset managers, financial infrastructures and industrial capital.

programme.title: 直播丨2026上海全球资产管理论坛
programme.desc: 上海作为国家金融开放枢纽门户，依托完备的金融市场基础设施、内外资机构集聚生态与持续迭代的互联互通机制，天然承担起链接全球资本与国内市场、统筹发展与安全的核心使命。在此时代节点，第一财经联合中国银行再度主办上海全球资产管理论坛，以顶层视角贯通国家中长期战略部署与上海全球资管中心最新政策蓝图，搭建监管、学界、中外头部资管、金融基础设施、产业资本的高端对话平台。

programme.title: 直播丨2026 Shanghai Global Asset Management Forum–International Session
programme.desc: Against the backdrop of profound reshaping of the global asset management landscape, high-level bilateral financial openness between China and France is advancing in depth. For the sixth consecutive year, Yicai Media Group and Bank of China jointly host the Shanghai Global Asset Management Forum and specially convene this international session as the opening event of the “Global Asset Management Centre · Shanghai International Week”. At this year’s international session, Bank of China and the French Asset Management Association will jointly present the China-France Asset Management Dialogue. The session brings together representatives from industry association, leading asset managers and financial infrastructures of both countries.

programme.title: 直播丨2026上海全球资产管理论坛·国际化专场
programme.desc: 当前，全球资管格局深度重塑，中法金融高水平双向开放正向纵深迈进。作为“全球资产管理中心·上海国际活动周”的首场活动，第一财经连续六年携手中国银行，联合主办上海全球资产管理论坛，并特设国际化专场。今年的国际化专场，中国银行将与法国资管协会联合呈现中法资管对话。会议汇聚中法两国行业组织、头部资管机构及金融基础设施代表，共同见证中法资管协会合作备忘录的签署，以及中法合资合作的成果发布，打造双边合作机制化的新起点。专场将围绕“全球资管中心建设经验”与“养老金融及长期资本”展开深度探讨，依托上海作为金融开放枢纽门户的优势，以顶层视角链接中欧市场，共探跨境资产配置新路径，以开放合作汇聚全球资本，共促上海国际金融中心能级跃升。
